templates.why_chosen: Double-column (aspect 4.12), the widest clean hub-spoke: control subsystem, then a coloured heterogeneous topology, then a per-node zoom.
templates.what_to_learn: At double column a hub-spoke becomes three left-to-right zones (controller / topology / one-node detail) with the legend below.

templates.why_chosen: High-confidence nested-stack exemplar where the Coordinator box nests a Profiler, a Placement Planner and a Scheduler stacked inside it, while a separate Compute Node panel nests three alternating Queue and Layer boxes, across 18 components.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack a coordinator's internal stages inside its own labelled box in top-to-bottom order even when the rest of the figure runs left to right, and keep a node's repeated queue-then-layer pairs the same size and colour so the pattern itself shows the pipeline running inside one node.

templates.why_chosen: Also a named hub-spoke exemplar: three panels run left to right, Coordinator internals, a colour-typed cluster graph, and one Compute Node's queue/layer chain pulled into a zoomed panel by a dashed connector, legend below.
templates.what_to_learn: Chain three different kinds of panel left to right (control logic, then a topology graph, then one zoomed node) rather than forcing one drawing to hold all three, and put a single legend below spanning all of them since node colour and the layer icon both need explaining.
